Name: Ultravisor — Promiscuous (no login)
Description: Bare-minimum stack: a single Ultravisor with no auth beacon attached.  The web UI loads straight to the dashboard with no login screen — session-gated routes synthesize anonymous sessions because no provider could possibly mint a real one.  Useful for local development, automation testing, and as a smoke check that the UI works without an auth backend at all.

DataRoot.Description: Where Ultravisor state (operation library, manifest store) persists on the host.

MonorepoRoot.Description: Path to your retold monorepo checkout. Ultravisor is built from MonorepoRoot/modules/apps/ultravisor at launch.

UVPort.Description: Host port for the Ultravisor API + web UI.
